intents_zh: sed 整個資料夾找替換
code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
ROOT="{{root_dir}}"
FROM='{{from_str}}'
TO='{{to_str}}'

find "$ROOT" -type f -name '{{file_glob}}' -print0 | \
  xargs -0 grep -l "$FROM" 2>/dev/null | \
  xargs -I{} sed -i.bak "s|$FROM|$TO|g" {}

find "$ROOT" -name '*.bak' -delete
echo 'replace done'
